verdict.rationale: The dots docs say the same dot can be opened in the ChatGPT mobile app once the supporting update is available, so official mobile access is documented but conditional and not yet clearly shipped. Nothing shows which mobile features work, and some functions, such as inspecting delegated work under Activity, are documented only for the desktop app. Missing for 10: confirmed general availability, explicit iOS and Android coverage, evidence of feature parity on mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
